title: NCAA: Cajucom stars as Saint Benilde avoids upset against San Sebastian
summary: Josh Cajucom stepped up as College of Saint Benilde avoided an upset against San Sebastian College with a 73-66 win in NCAA Season 102 on Monday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
